title: WarrantLattice
description: SP-PATT-WARR-001 §1.3, §2.2, §3.1-3.2. The normative lattice binding consequence class C to the warrant floor minW(C), the attestation quorum Q(C), the evidence decay half-life, the hysteresis thresholds, and the concentration caps. Q is monotone non-decreasing in C and independent of W_p. Decay half-life shortens with C: higher consequence must be more freshly re-earned.

minW.description: Floor on W_p required for a manifest at class C to remain live (Grant conjunct W_p >= minW(C)).

quorum.description: Attestation quorum required at declaration per class. Monotone non-decreasing in C; independent of W_p.

decayHalfLifeDays.description: §3.1 tau_C. Evidence weight decays with half-life dependent on the manifest's class.

hysteresis.description: §3.2 asymmetric promote/demote with dwell. theta_up(L) > theta_down(L) for all L; d_down < d_up by design.

thetaUp.description: Promotion thresholds per target level. Placeholders pending scoring-function choice (OI-1).

thetaDown.description: Demotion thresholds per level. Placeholders pending scoring-function choice (OI-1).

concentrationCaps.description: §2.2 principal-concentration cap on W_p. A single principal or compromised session must not synthesize enough repetition to reach C2/C3 eligibility.

machineDerivedExempt.description: When true, a machine-derived evidence-independent pattern satisfies this ceiling with no behavioral diversity.
